reviews.text:
My six-year-old Shih Tzu, Coco, has been going to Pup Town Spaw for several years. After I moved, getting her to appointments became more difficult, so I was thrilled to discover their mobile grooming service!

I booked with Rudy Aguilar, and he did a fabulous job! He was punctual, professional, and had such a calm, friendly presence. Coco has anxiety, but she did great with him, which meant so much to me. She looks beautiful!

Highly recommend Rudy and Pup Town Spaw’s mobile grooming service! 🐾❤️
We have been using pup town spa for years. Tabby has always been the groomer for my yorkie Oliver. She always does an exceptional job and she gives Ollie the utmost care & love. We love Tabby!!!

My family and I have been long time clients of Elli, and she always takes great care of our dog and cat. She carefully listens to what we want and makes sure we’re happy with her work. She’s also kind and sweet, which makes working with her much easier. I look forward to every time she comes out to our house! Your pets would be in great hands with Elli!
Got me in right away as a walk in

3rd time that I take her and yesterday I was charge an extra 10.00 because my dog had an accident which is weird because she is kennel trained it’s not the money, but they are pups and accidents will happen they just lost my business….
Took both my rough collies on two different days, didn't feel rushed and I used self wash. Everyone is super nice! Thanks! Ra and Hermes are happy clean boys!

My husband and I are new pet owners. We have had her 3 months. We tried to trim her nails, but she was not having it. I found this place by looking up self wash. I like the fact that they provide towels, blow dryer, shampoo, and spray. No mess in my bathroom. The lady that usually works in the back that covers for the lady up front was so nice. Both ladies there were very nice. I was scared because our Puppy horse was huge, and not a fan of people. Well she was able to trim her nails, and we were able to give her a bath. Well my husband did. Thank you so much for being so patient and kind. I am just a nervous wreck with Zaza because she is Skitches. Will go here for nail trims and baths. I would like to add that the place was clean, and nice.

Loved their services! My dog is super difficult when it comes to nails and Angie handle him perfectly(he's a big baby). He came back nice and shiny and smelled really good! They also did a shed-less treatment and it definitely helped his shedding alot since he's short haired but has a lot of hair

Disappointed My wife had a problem with our dogs Harnessed being broken it wasn't broken when we left him so My wife did speak to a manager . The manager said she had to look over the cameras to see what happened to the harness . They looked at the footage and they didn't in fine anything  The Manager  Offered To get a new harnessed For our dog Just not the one that we purchased They have are records , we go there regularly At least once a month .I work in a business where customers tell me if something's wrong.I make sure I fix it, especially if I have good customers.it takes years to hold on to a customer , but it takes one day to lose one
Having a mobile grooming service is money well spent!  My Clover loves her groomer, Tara!  My doggie gets so excited when she sees her groomer!!!  Thank you so much.

About a month ago, I took my Shih Tzu to Pup Town for a bath and haircut. I gave clear, simple instructions: a teddy bear face and a specific blade length for his body.

About an hour later, I received a call from the receptionist saying my dog had “accidentally been shaved.” At first, I thought there had to be some misunderstanding, so I called back. That’s when I was told that the wrong groomer had taken the wrong dog from the wrong kennel and completely shaved my Shih Tzu.

When I say completely shaved, I mean everything. His signature teddy bear face and his long tail were shaved down with the shortest blade. I barely recognized my own dog when I picked him up.

Before arriving, I told the receptionist that I wanted to speak with the manager, but I was informed the manager wasn’t there that day. Initially, they said they would only charge me for the bath, but I made it clear I wasn’t willing to pay for any service because my dog was groomed without my authorization and completely contrary to the instructions I had given.

The receptionist was incredibly kind, apologetic, and professional. She told me she had spoken with the manager and that all charges would be waived. She also assured me the manager would call me the following day.

That call never came.

My poor baby was shaved so closely that, in the middle of summer, he had to wear a sweater at night because he was shivering from being cold. It was heartbreaking to see him so uncomfortable because of a mistake that should never have happened.

I understand that mistakes happen, and thankfully my dog’s hair will eventually grow back. However, what I can’t overlook is how poorly this situation was handled afterward. A sincere apology and a follow-up from management would have gone a long way.

Because of the lack of accountability and customer service, I will never return to Pup Town, nor would I recommend them to anyone.

UNACCEPTABLE. I won’t ever be back after years going here. Been going here since they opened. Went to get dog’s nails trimmed as I have done for years. Front desk lady said “new company policy I need a shot record”. WHAT?  No email or text messages about this new policy? I get advertising from you all the time and follow on FB. ZERO NOTICE.  Of course I would’ve brought it with me. Showed them vets appt 4/19/2026 $169 in my checking account for new shots & refused to do nails & let me send records when I got back home. UNPROFESSIONAL. DISORGANIZED not to reach out & simply let customers know.

Marcelo did an INCREDIBLE for my fur babies groom! We are obsessed with his corgi cut, and he smells amazing! We are definitely going to be coming back for his next appointment. He looked so handsome in his bandana as well ☺️

Be aware of the bandana. The bandana was used to cover up this close shave.

Mention of the short cut was on the face. That is why I did not post those pictures of that error. NO ONE said anything about the neck. But I can continue and tell the whole experience of that appointment. Yea it will grow back duh. It is the fact that it was not mentioned. I trusted this facility to tell me what my fur baby can't.
I used to love their services but I got ghosted after a few loyal years. So I’m not sure what happened
Awesome job

My Cavapoo recently had his first professional grooming; unfortunately I was very disappointed.

I explained several times that I had never had a dog groomed before and asked for guidance. We discussed the available length options, and I selected the middle length with a typical teddy bear style. When Flynn was returned to me, he barely appeared trimmed at all and looked closer to the longest length option instead of what we had discussed.

After I expressed concern, they took him back to adjust the groom. Unfortunately, the result looked uneven and choppy rather than blended and polished. His face was cute, but his body, neck, and back looked unfinished and boxy, with uneven areas throughout the coat.

To their credit, management did offer to have him come back in for another correction after I sent photos. However, during that visit I could hear Flynn yelping multiple times, and I heard the groomer loudly telling him to “stop.” This was especially upsetting because the original groomer had told me he behaved like “a perfect gentleman” during the first appointment.

I understand puppy coats can be more difficult to groom evenly, especially with Cavapoos/doodles, and I was not expecting absolute perfection. However, I did expect a more professional finish and a calmer, more reassuring experience for a puppy’s first groom.

Another issue that really bothered me was the cleanliness outside the shop. When I first arrived for the appointment, there were three piles of dog waste on the sidewalk directly in front of the business, despite signage asking owners to clean up after their pets and offering waste bags.

When I returned approximately 2.5 hours later, the waste was still there. Three days later, when I took him back, one of the piles had been stepped in and smeared across the sidewalk while the others were finally gone. I understand pet owners should clean up after their own dogs, but leaving waste sitting outside the entrance for days in a shared shopping center reflects poorly on the business as well.

Because of the overall experience, I do not feel comfortable returning, and I now worry that Flynn may associate grooming with stress rather than a positive experience.
Always an excellent grooming

I definitely liked this place. I liked it for its convenience and how friendly the staff was. Lupe, answered all my questions she was friendly and had a nice smile. Not to mention she was friendly with my dog.
I used the self service station and they had everything I needed to take my dog a bath. It was  nice experience being that I know my dog has anxiety going to the groomer. She felt comfortable with me being in the groomers seat.

I had a great experience at this grooming spa. Daniele took excellent care of my dog, Mocha, and the grooming was top-notch. Jesika at the front desk was wonderful—professional, kind, and very organized. From start to finish, everything was smooth. I’ll definitely be coming back.

Dropped off my dog at 12pm, by 4:54 i called wondering how much longer since they were closing early. Whoever answered the phone rudely stated they hadn’t started on him and needed another hour or more before we could pick him up. Considering the holiday we opted to just pick him up since it had been hours already, she stated we weren’t allowed to since a bath was rendered and if we opted to pick him up we would need to pay, which is fine. When arrived at the salon it was VERY apparent my dog had not received a bath and was immediately hit with a $60 bill. when questioned if he was even bathed the employee got very rude and threatened to call the police if we didn’t pay. And to make matters worse my dog has other dogs feces and urine on him, the most disappointing experience highly do not recommend this place.

UPDATE: Someone by the name Priscilla called us accusing us of lying asking us to fix our review so they could look better,  following up with non stop arguing, this is the most UNPROFESSIONAL experience i’ve ever had with any sort of establishment. You get what you give , blessings to your 2026 Priscilla and Jessica.

Thank you for hosting our fundraiser. We appreciate your help so much. Thank you for being so kind and generous. You have a good heart and really helped us in our time of need. God bless you and your business

Marcelo is the only one I trust with my dog, he’s very difficult to handle, but Marcelo does great with him! Pup Town Spaw is very attentive and very good at what they do, every time I pick up my babies they smell so good and they are very clean!

Friendly staff, explained everything and showed us around the self wash station. Really cool setup was an easy wash, shampoo smelled great and leave in conditioner had my boy soft and smelling amazing! The ear cleaner and pads were included it was great. Next time I will bring the nail clippers to get him all complete. They gave him a treat after and complimentary spray of doggie cologne. Definitely will be back!
The groomers here must all be touched by angels. My dog is extremely sensitive and they take care of him just as if he was one of their own.
Great clean up job.

This place has its own UNDISCLOSED operating hours. This is the 4th time I’ve drove all the way over here and they closed early with no notice anywhere except on the door. It’s 5pm on a Friday and I’m just trying to bathe my dog.

What a waste of time and energy trekking my dog here for nothing! It’s usually an hour or so right before as if someone just decided to leave early. So unprofessional and inconsiderate!
Great prices on bathing and grooming! Self wash bays are also great. Perfect location and friendly staff! Highly recommend them!

This business does not know what customer service is.  The charge for a self serve dog wash with tax is $22.80 - they do not have change for $25.00.  This is not the fault of the customer!   Do not expect the customer to correct your issue of not having change! Either keep change on hand or accept the $21.00 offered.

This was the very first time that the groomer didn’t follow my request in trimming my Schnauzer’s tail. She shaved it completely. Mistakes happen however I’d certainly as. A groomer would have made sure that trimmed wasn’t misunderstood for shave completely. My Schnauzer’s tail has not been docked so why would you think I asked to have it shaved completely. My Schnauzer, has been going here for several months.

Took my German shepherd to Pup Town Spa and Angie absolutely crushed it. My girl came out super fluffy and shiny walked out fluffier than a cotton ball & her coat was sparkling.

Angie clearly knows her way around a double coat. She handled my girl with care and confidence, and the results speak for themselves. If your dog needs a glow-up, Angie’s the one to call.

Highly recommend Pup Town Spa—and especially Angie—for anyone who wants their pup looking fresh.

Great place for pampering your furbaby. Staff is friendly and listens to your dogs needs. Plus you get reward points on every visit. My doggo always comes home looking and smelling good. Appointments are easy to make as well. Usually there is a 2 hour window from when you drop off doggo to be ready.

Me and my dog had such a pleasant experience. I came for the self wash and they had everything I needed! The lady was very accommodating and super helpful. I saw some reviews about people complaining that you have to dry the dog in the tub that you wash them in and honestly I think that’s ridiculous. This little place and it’s set up is perfect for a self dog wash especially if you have a scared dog like I do. So go experience it for yourself don’t listen to some of these other reviews lol

Been bringing my baby here for a little over a year and they always do a wonderful job. Great prices, and convenience of scheduling everything online! Staff is always friendly, will continue to return!
We've been taking our dogs here for nearly two years now and we love it! Our pups come home so clean and soft and the staff are always super friendly!
Take my dog here all the time. Fast and friendly. Def the most affordable in town

I brought my super shy and skittish German Shepherd in for a self-service wash, and it was such a great experience! The staff was incredibly friendly and took the time to explain everything included with the self-wash. They made me feel comfortable, which helped my dog feel more at ease too. I really appreciated that the wash time was unlimited. It gave us the chance to go at our own pace without feeling rushed. Highly recommend, and I’ll definitely be coming back!
Horrible. Waited 15 minutes and no service

DO NOT TAKE YOUR ANIMALS HERE. We have given this place 3x to fix any issues errors. 1) We had taken our dog here and he came back SCARED, NOT EATING, and he was NOT ACTING NORMAL for 5 days straight, 2) My grandma had taken her dog here and her dog came come smelling horrible. As if they did not even wash her or anything. It was very strange and weird….., 3) we have taken our other dog here twice already and they always seem to do something wrong. This last time we had taken her, her eye brows were RED, RAW, and BLEEDING. Please stay away from this place, I did not have a good feeling the very first time I had taken our dog here and I should have went with the Holy Spirit with the feeling I had.

The bathtub I used didn’t seem to be cleaned and sanitized. The steps for the dog to use to get in the tub were broken so I had to carry my dog. There’s no drying table, you have to dry the dog in the tub, and the bottom of the dog remains damp. They offer shampoo and etc… but I always use mine. It’s a place for people don’t really know how to groom their dogs and don’t care if the dog is wet or dry and about quality of product. I’d also recommend for smaller dogs. That  you car lift and put in the tub. They charge too much and offer too little. I went because it’s close to my house and I saw bad reviews on the other place I used to take.
I love it my Sophia looks beautiful 👍😁 …

The staff here are absolutely fantastic! They genuinely love their jobs and take great care of your furry friends. And guess what? The self-wash station is super affordable and offers top-notch products like shampoos, leave-in conditioners, the best blow dryers, and even dog cologne or perfume.

I recently took my Samoyed to get groomed. When I went to pick him up, I discovered that although they shaved him, they did not bathe him, do his nails, or clean his ears.   When inquiring about it, the girl at the front desk just nervously laughed. After spending 150 dollars on grooming services, Pup Town Spaw damn sure needs to do what is advertised and what the customer is paying for. I've been a customer there for over 2 years,  but no more.
Wonderful staff and Marcelo always does a phenomenal job with my dogs Lola and Layla!  Marcelo is amazing with them!
I didn't tell my wife and kids I was taking the dog for a grooming, they loved her new look.
Super affordable. Staff is very nice and accommodating. Usually always have availabilities throughout the week and if not they have a self service dog wash. I can not recommend this place enough!

I like taking my dog here! I regularly go in for a self-wash because its so convenient. The staff is friendly and helpful and they provide a clean space and everything I need to for a smooth experience.
Great self-wash subscription! Staff is very friendly and helpful.

Tara is wonderful! We used mobile option, Tara was on time, professional, friendly and patient with our 3 pups. All three look great and smell lovely. We have 2 rescues that are extremely skittish around strangers, Tara was great with them. Very convenient service, paying was a breeze and I will use on a regular basis. Highly recommend

My 3 big dogs were walk-in customers for nail trims.  Staff members were friendly and seemed happy to work there.  Izzie did the nails of all 3 and she was very nice and helpful.  Thank you so much!  Will come back here again.
Used self serve wash. Walk ins and appts allowed. Staff was helpful and friendly and the price was a real value
I enjoy taking our little chihuahua here for her spa day and she always has a smile on her fav e when I come pick her up. The staff are super friendly and very accommodating. I highly recommend!
I love this place. My dogs come out amazing, the staff is amazing, it's all.... AMAZING
Dog smell nice now.
Easy and well set up self dog wash station.
I never have any issues when we visit Pup Town Spa. The staff is super friendly and Marcelo always leaves our Lola looking and smelling amazing! The prices are reasonable and options plentiful.
Nice place to give your dog a nice bath

Have been going to this place for over a year my pet had a terrible experience at a prior grooming place that cost a lot of anxiety. Ever since I started taking her here and Marcelo taking care of her she has never had any change of behavior. She’s herself after her appointment and is able to be calm during her appointment as well, which is a huge plus because the prior place would constantly tell me that they required a muscle on her which I always felt like that was a bit excessive. however, at this spot, my baby is always happy and I know that she is safe and her hair is always amazing and she smells great so it makes me really happy to know that my pet is being taken care of properly and I would 100% recommend this place for any pet owners who are concerned about their pets anxiety while getting groomed. also, thank you so much Marcelo for doing such an amazing job strawberry and I appreciate you very much!!
Exactly what i was looking for with their self service. Recommend to bring your own brushes if thats your need but their equipment and cleanliness is definitely top. Thank you!
Wonderful employees here. They are very friendly, professional, and very good with my pup. Thank you guys! You have a repeated customer for sure

My dog, Sam, has been going to Pup Town Spaw for about 3 years. He has a standing appointment every 4 weeks with Jeni.

Jeni is very careful grooming around all his lumps, bumps, and warts. She always gives a very consistent grooming each time.

I’ve also used Danielle and she is very good also.
Excellent place for my dog ​​to get a bath, nail trim, and teeth brushing
the staff is really nice, I went to get my cats nails trimmed and not only was it affordable it was quick and easy.
Chico and coco love to come here and get showered and groomed the staff here is very friendly and never disappoint me thank you everyone .
I have been taking my dog since they first opened. I have yet to be an unsatisfied customer. They have been great! My doggie agrees too!

I have two shih tzu/schnauzer mix puppies.  Pup Town Spaw is the only groomer that could get them exactly how I wanted them.  I had tried other groomers but this time their cuts were perfect.  They came out looking and smelling so good.  I was definitely a happy customer. I would recommend them to all my friends and family.

They did such a great job with grinding the nails on my very anxious and tricky pit mix. It took three of us to get all paws done, but they never stopped or gave up and allowed me to stay back to help his nerves. We've been turned away at other places so I cannot thank Pup Town Space enough!
Took in my puppy schnauzer, and this is the quality of work they did. Very disappointed and will never return. Horrible!!

We have a shy dog that prefers peaceful environments and Pup town is a salon I trust she is okay at. When I walked in yesterday to pick her up the atmosphere was very calm and quiet which leads me to believe that the dogs are kept comfortable and happy.  She is finished in a timely manner and she looks great afterwards.
